newsitem.title: USA: Orange & Rockland sets stock buybacks.
newsitem.headline: Orange & Rockland sets stock buybacks.

text.p: Orange & Rockland Utilities Inc said Monday if filed Friday for regulatory approval to repurchase up to 700,000 common shares.
The buyback program, if approved, will enable the company to repurchase the stock from time to time through December 31, 1999, it said in a statement.
The 700,000 shares represent about five percent of the shares outstanding, the utility said.
Orange & Rockland also said it agreed to a new labor contract with members of Local 503 of the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers.

The company said wages will increase 10 percent over three-year pact, which also provides for pension plan and other retirement-related improvements as well. In return, the agreement "provides for employee contributions for health care costs and work rule changes, which together essentially offset cost increases."
